name: Oren-Nayar two-light boards
description: Two upward-facing boards of equal built-in Diffuse materials, side by side, one material each so the cook keeps them as two World slots, seen from 30 degrees off their normal. Scene sources cannot author lights: the World adds two directional lights. Assign the project Oren-Nayar material of oren-nayar-provider.luscene.json to the Project board; the Control board keeps the built-in Lambertian material.
